decision.explanation: The question asks who is 'starring' as Mulan. Source D3S1 explicitly states Yifei Liu was cast to portray the titular role of Mulan in the film (referring to the 2020 live-action version). Source D2S1 states Ming-Na Wen stars as Mulan in the English version of the movie (referring to the 1998 animated version). The name 'Mi Yang' in D1S1 appears to be an error or alias for Yifei Liu (often cited as Liu Yifei), but 'Yifei Liu' is the standard and correct name provided in D3S1. Since the question does not specify which version of 'Mulan', both the actress from the 2020 film (Yifei Liu) and the actress from the 1998 English version (Ming-Na Wen) are valid answers representing distinct productions. The audit label 'wrong_argument' for Ming-Na Wen is incorrect because she does star as Mulan in the specified version mentioned in the text.
